title: Number wall on lock screen causing other apps to restart
body:
External Android apps appear to restart at the precise Xdrip+ polling interval. (Chrome web content refreshes, clearing unsubmitted input fields; social media feeds refresh to the top of the scroll; YouTube videos stop and reset to the beginning; etc.)

Observed after I migrated to a new phone. Current specs:

Google Pixel 6 Pro
Android 12 (5 Nov 2021 update) build number SD1A.210817.037.A1
Xdrip+ nightly build version efb7508-2021.12.02
Collectors for Dexcom G6 on which behavior was observed: 640G/EverSense, Dexcom Share

The full narrative of the behavior observed was reported first in [this discussion thread](https://github.com/Navid200/xDrip/discussions/150).

comments.body:
Suggestion from @jamorham: 

If apps are being interrupted generally when xDrip is doing something then I would expect it is memory pressure. If the user has a large number of historical readings they could enable the data retention settings to automatically prune the database and see if that helps.

Thanks for passing on that suggestion @Navid200 , but I don't think limiting the history will help in this instance. This is a new phone (Pixel 6 Pro) and so it's a relatively new install of Xdrip+. The history only goes back to November 9, 2021. And I first noticed this behavior ... oh, about a week after that date.
@CountScotula So, when you installed xDrip on this phone, you did not restore a database from your previous installations on your previous phones?

@Navid200 I did not. I use Xdrip+ mainly for display on my watch and for its predictive features that seem more useful to me than my OmniPod bolus calculator. So, I only backed up and restored my settings from the old installation, not the db.

What apps have you installed on the phone other than xDrip?

I mean no matter how powerful your phone is, if you install enough apps on it, you can bring it to its knees.

Oh, very many. But fewer than on my Pixel 4 that preceded it with 6GB RAM. The Pixel 6 Pro has 12GB RAM. I really really don't think this is a resources problem. Remember too, I'm *only* seeing this happen when Xdrip+ polls. If I was blowing it out, I'd see this with many more intensive operations.

There are other xDrip users who are using that same phone.

Sometimes, it's very easy to identify the cause of a problem.
But, that's not always the case.  Then, the only thing left to do is to suspect everything.

Considering there are other users who are using that phone with xDrip, I suspect you have an app that is the cause of the problem.
My suggestion is meant to help us identify that app.

Oh, I understand that. I'm just doubting the idea that the *number* of apps aren't bringing my phone "to its knees."

Presumably if it were a particular app, it would be one that the permission to run in the background, yes? As I understand Android, apps without this permission are held in stasis when not active. Would it be useful to know which apps on my phone have that permission?

I came across this through Google. Pixel 5 with the same issue since the Android 12 update.
Every time xdrip polls Facebook or Web browser refreshes.

I cannot image xDrip is the root cause of this behavior because xDrip does nothing special. Maybe, this is caused by the Bluetooth stack. Can anyone connect it to a computer and use logcat to monitor what happens?

I'm just commenting to say that I'm also experiencing this issue on a Pixel 4a running Android 12 and xDrip+. I have barely any other apps on the phone. This definitely isn't a lack of resources issue. I have xDrip+ working with Freestyle Libre, miaomiao and Miband4 watch. It's got so bad that I am now carrying 2 phones, an old Pixel 1 for xDrip etc and my 4a for everything else. Someone on the xDrip Facebook page pointed me this way. It's nice to see that I'm not the only one with this issue! Tim

As there is some interest in this issue I'll switch back to using the 4a with xDrip+ again and endure the annoyance. Maybe I can help with some testing or something.

Wow I've been experiencing this issue ever since getting my Pixel 6.  I always figured it was a bug in the new Android 12 system.  But I would post on reddit and could never really find anyone else having the issue.

If it is Xdrip causing this, it would explain why a lot of people aren't.

I think we can rule out Bluetooth as the issue because my Bluetooth is never enabled.  I use Xdrip with the Dexcom Share setting.

I'm using 2021-12-08.

I'll start testing some settings now that this may be the culprit.

I've tried toggling the following and the issue occurs no matter whether checked or not. 
- Aggressive Service Restarts
- Run Collector in foreground
- Samsung Workarounds

Hi michaeld427. As I understand it from googling a while ago, this issue occurs with Dexcom as well as xDrip+. By that I mean that people solely using Dexcom (not in combination with xDrip+) are experiencing this, so in your case it may be Dexcom that is causing the issue. I was fairly certain this was a Bluetooth issue, but as I have no experience with Dexcom, I'm not aware of what communication protocol that uses.
Oh, thanks for the suggestion, @Navid200. Yes, it certainly would, so I've made that edit.
We may be able to find out why this happens and solve it.  So, I would like to keep this open please.  Please let me know if I am overlooking something in that respect.

Just wanted to add, I experience this too. My setup is accessing data from Dexcom share. I decided to to spend some time today focusing on what was causing it. For me, it force closes clash of clans and clash royal. It also causes the camera to quit recording if you have are actively recording. I narrowed it down to only occurring when xDrip+ refreshes. This is a new Pixel 6 pro with plenty of free resources. It happened on my previous Pixel 4XL as well. It started on that phone when I upgraded to Android 12. I have now disabled the lockscreen feature. 
**If it matters, the camera stopping recording occurred when there was a xDrip+ alert. It happened twice while I was recording my kid playing soccer. The Clash games issue happens on just a normal 5 minute cycle. 
** Removing the value from the lock screen has 100% fixed the issue.
